owned_invariants: One request in flight at a time.
After a timeout or EOF no further call is attempted.
boundaries: Speaks exactly the protocol of pfp_lab/cli/rpc.py.

score.level_basis: Line-framed JSON-RPC client with serialised calls, per-call timeout and cancellation, envelope and id checks, a channel that faults after desynchronisation, and the typed CoreException translation.

basis.G1: Header declares AuthorityEffect: None and a unique contract URN; the exported names (__all__ or public types) are the ones the docstring describes and the contract lists. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond this contract.
basis.G2: Responses are accepted only for the matching id and version; malformed answers are Protocol errors; a timeout or closed stream faults the channel.
basis.G3: Typed failures: every core failure becomes CoreException with a CoreErrorKind (RULE_CS_002 checks run after deserialisation; no null-forgiving operator in runtime code, enforced by a scan); async methods take and forward CancellationToken (CA2016 as error); disposables are disposed (CA2000/CA1816 as error). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit tests, view-model tests with a scripted client, and contract tests against the real Python core. Mutation R = 1/1 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Cyclomatic complexity from lizard and CA1502 (threshold 10, error at build); nesting from the brace estimate. Cognitive complexity is not measured for C#, so A is not claimed. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 9, cognitive None, nesting 2; metrics ceiling A+.
